title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
human hepatocyte regeneration
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract labels PAI1 as senescence-inducing but does not explicitly analyze, induce, reverse, or compare a senescent state; it also uses only a generic multi-omics label without naming current-report molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study in primary human hepatocytes. Regeneration and proliferation are analyzed, but cellular senescence is not itself explicitly analyzed. The generic multi-omics wording does not establish two distinct molecular omics layers.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: p53 and PAI1 inhibition and hepatocyte proliferation
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Wnt activation was sufficient to inhibit p53/PAI1 and drive proliferation of >50% of PHH.
